name: Hide Added To Cart notification for WooCommerce
author: Voordelig ICT

sections.description:
This plugin removes the default WooCommerce message that appears when a customer adds a product to their cart. Normally WooCommerce shows a notification such as “Product added to your cart. Continue shopping”, often displayed as a green message bar at the top of the page. On many shops this message can be distracting, unnecessary, or visually inconsistent with the design.

With this plugin the notification is completely hidden, creating a smoother shopping experience without altering any other WooCommerce behavior. Products are still added correctly to the cart, no functionality is changed, only the visual message is removed.

The plugin is lightweight, contains no settings, and works instantly after activation. It does not load extra scripts or styles, and therefore has zero impact on site performance.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plug-in files to the \\’/wp-content/plugins/\\’ folder, or install from the WordPress plugin library.
  2. Activate the plug-in from the WordPress plug-in menu.
  3. The message is now hidden; no further configuration required.
sections.faq:
Q: Does this plugin remove all WooCommerce notices?

A: No. It only hides the “added to cart” notification. Other important notices such as errors, stock warnings, and checkout messages remain visible.

Q: Does it affect how the cart works?

A: No. Products are added normally. Only the visual notification is suppressed.

Q: Will this break my theme?

A: No. The plugin uses an official WooCommerce filter and does not modify templates or scripts.
